This API will be used to notify CM about any update on the already linked care context for a patient.
This API will be used by HIP to send SMS notification to patient that a care context is linked.
This API will be invoked by the HIP for sharing the response of /api/hiecm/user-initiated-linking/v3/link/care-context/on-confirm API

As a result of the initialization, HIP has to generate a unique reference-number in the link object which is called as link-reference-number and it has to trigger a OTP (token) to the patient's mobile number that is present with the HIP/HMIS/LIMS which will be provided back to HIP for validation during confirm request flow.
HMIS/LIMS/HIP has to ensure that only unlinked records of the patient has to be shared through this API.
This is a callback api to notify hip when consent is APPROVED or REVOKED.
API used to generate link token to link the health records

reply.Text:
Based on the ABDM documentation, here's where to find M2 API details and sequences:

## Main M2 Flow Documentation
The **flow documentation** shows the API sequence for the main M2 workflows. For example:
- **[Link a care context to a patient's ABHA](https://docs.abdm.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m2#m2-link-care-context)** — this portal page shows the complete API call sequence for M2

## Individual M2 APIs
All M2 operations are documented individually. Here's what's available:

**HIP-initiated Linking:**
- Generate Link Token
- Link care contexts to an ABHA
- Notify updates to linked care contexts
- Send SMS notifications to patients

**User-initiated Linking (patient discovers & links their own records):**
- On-Discover: HIP responds with found care contexts
- On-Init: HIP responds with OTP communication details
- On-Confirm: HIP confirms linked care contexts

**Consent & Data Flow:**
- Acknowledge consent notifications
- Acknowledge health information requests
- Notify data transfer completion

**Plus callbacks** for all these operations (what ABDM sends back to you)

## How to Navigate
1. Start with the **[flow page](https://docs.abdm.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m2#m2-link-care-context)** for the end-to-end sequence
2. Click into each individual endpoint for request/response schemas
3. Check the **errors section** for M2 error codes and their meanings
4. Review **concepts** like care contexts, callbacks, and asynchronous patterns
